info.best_time_val: Apr – Oct for trekking · Year-round waterfalls

overview.title: Welcome to Azilal — High Atlas wilderness, waterfalls, and ancient valleys
overview.p1: Nestled in the heart of Morocco’s Central High Atlas, Azilal province is a dramatic landscape of deep canyons, snow-capped peaks, terraced agricultural valleys, and geological wonders recognised by UNESCO.
overview.p2: Home to the world-famous Ouzoud Waterfalls, the idyllic Ait Bouguemez valley known as the 'Happy Valley', the azure waters of Lake Bin el Ouidane, and prehistoric dinosaur tracks, Azilal is the ultimate playground for hikers and nature lovers.

places.title: Must-visit places in Azilal
places.subtitle: Majestic waterfalls, pristine mountain valleys, and ancient geological sites.

ouzoud.title: Ouzoud Waterfalls
ouzoud.desc: Morocco's most spectacular 110m cascading waterfalls, rainbow pools, and resident Barbary macaques.

bouguemez.title: Ait Bouguemez (Happy Valley)
bouguemez.desc: A lush green mountain valley of traditional Berber villages, apple orchards, and iconic hiking trails.

binelouidane.title: Lake Bin el Ouidane
binelouidane.desc: A stunning turquoise alpine reservoir surrounded by red cliffs, popular for boating and peaceful stays.

dinosaurs.title: Iouaridene Dinosaur Footprints
dinosaurs.desc: Prehistoric sauropod footprints preserved in rock layers in the central High Atlas mountains.

demnate.title: Imi n'Ifri Natural Bridge
demnate.desc: An astonishing natural stone arch bridge near Demnate carved by subterranean river erosion.

cathedral.title: Cathedrale Rock (Anergui)
cathedral.desc: A colossal geological rock formation resembling a mountain cathedral overlooking the Ahansal river canyon.

museum.title: M'Goun Geopark Museum
museum.desc: Modern museum in Azilal town showcasing dinosaur skeletons, fossils, and Atlas geological history.

zaouia.title: Zaouia Ahansal
zaouia.desc: Historic spiritual sanctuary and stone granaries tucked deep within dramatic Atlas gorges.

tips.title: Practical tips for Azilal & High Atlas

transport.title: Getting around
transport.desc: Renting a 4x4 or car from Marrakech is best for exploring mountain passes, Ouzoud, and Ait Bouguemez roads.

bargain.title: Mountain weather
bargain.desc: High Atlas weather changes rapidly. Even in spring, mountain nights are chilly—pack warm layers and sturdy hiking boots.

water.title: Guides & Culture
water.desc: Hiring a local mountain guide in Ait Bouguemez enriches hikes, and carrying cash is essential as ATMs are scarce in remote valleys.

daytrips.title: Best excursions from Azilal
daytrips.subtitle: Explore surrounding gorges, lakes, and imperial cities.

marrakech.title: Marrakech (2.5 hrs)
marrakech.desc: Connect easily to the vibrant medina and palaces of Marrakech.

benimellal.title: Beni Mellal & Ain Asserdoune (1 hr)
benimellal.desc: Visit the historic spring garden and fortress overlooking the Tadla plain.

imilchil.title: Imilchil Lakes (Scenic Drive)
imilchil.desc: Drive through high mountain plateaus to the twin lakes of Isli and Tislit.

q1.question: How many days do I need in Azilal?
q1.answer: Three to four days are ideal to visit Ouzoud waterfalls, explore Ait Bouguemez valley, and relax by Lake Bin el Ouidane.

q2.question: What is the best time to visit Ait Bouguemez?
q2.answer: Spring (April to June) and Autumn (September to November) offer perfect trekking weather, green valleys, and pleasant temperatures.

q3.question: Can I see dinosaur footprints in Azilal?
q3.answer: Yes! Azilal is part of the M'Goun UNESCO Global Geopark, featuring authentic sauropod dinosaur footprints at Iouaridene and exhibits in Azilal museum.

q4.question: How do I get to Azilal?
q4.answer: Azilal is reachable by road in about 2.5 hours from Marrakech or 1 hour from Beni Mellal via well-paved national highways.

itinerary.title: Suggested 3-day plan for Azilal & High Atlas
itinerary.subtitle: Waterfalls first, then the Happy Valley and dinosaur heritage.

detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Arrive from Marrakech or Beni Mellal; hike down to the base of the 110m Ouzoud falls and spot wild monkeys.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Drive to Azilal town and visit the M'Goun Geopark Museum to explore regional fossils and history.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Check in to a traditional guesthouse or mountain hotel for a hearty Berber tagine dinner.
detailed_itinerary.day2_m: Morning — Drive to Ait Bouguemez Valley
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Journey through spectacular mountain passes into the legendary 'Happy Valley' of Ait Bouguemez.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: Explore terraced green fields, traditional mud-brick fortified granaries, and meet local villagers.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Stay in an authentic mountain gîte surrounded by towering High Atlas peaks.
detailed_itinerary.day3_md: Discover preserved prehistoric sauropod tracks embedded in the mountain rock formations.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ad: Relax by the turquoise waters of Lake Bin el Ouidane, take a boat ride, or enjoy lakeside lunch.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ed: Final panoramic views over the Atlas before returning to Marrakech or Beni Mellal.
